chapters.title: I. The Royal Audience
chapters.narration: In Alsperia, the wizard Algoreth Jon Goren seeks the lost scrolls of Byzantem. Their secret is passage between worlds. The royal court may know the road to Lorian.

beats.speaker: Archivist Mara
beats.text: Dorian the Seer was the scrolls' last keeper. He went west through Mistwood. The Caverns of Lorian hold the scrolls, but the old trail is lost.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: A map, a horse, and a night's shelter are yours. Bring back knowledge that may aid Alsperia.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Power travels with obligation, Master Goren. Remember whose trust opens this road.

chapters.title: II. Through Mistwood
chapters.narration: The royal map carries Algoreth into Mistwood. Old waystones promise a safe route, while unseen watchers stir beyond the trees.

beats.speaker: Scout Tessa
beats.text: I know this road. The moss hides snares; follow the pale stones and keep your spellbook ready.

beats.speaker: Tessa
beats.text: These tracks circle us. Something from the ruins hunts travellers after dusk.

beats.speaker: Dorian's inscription
beats.text: The path between worlds answers neither conquest nor fear. Carry a question worth the crossing.

chapters.title: III. The Caverns of Lorian
chapters.narration: Within Lorian, an ancient Byzantem arch guards a silver chest. Dorian's warning follows Algoreth into the dark.

beats.speaker: Dorian the Seer
beats.text: I kept the scrolls hidden from kings and thieves alike. Tell me why you would open a way to another world.

beats.speaker: Dorian
beats.text: The chest is protected by an old guardian. It knows no ambition, only the duty to keep the door closed.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The silver lid yields. The scrolls of Byzantem describe crossings to Glacium, Sirocco, Verdania, Oceania, and Ebonrealm.

chapters.title: IV. The King's Bargain
chapters.narration: Algoreth returns to Alsperia with the scrolls. The court's gift of passage has become a claim upon his discovery.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: Let our scholars copy the scrolls, so this power serves the realm rather than one wizard.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: A copy can spread knowledge. It can also arm every rival throne. Choose carefully who reads it first.

beats.speaker: Court Mage Ilyra
beats.text: The Sirocco passage is unstable. A damaged seal could open here, beneath the city itself.

chapters.title: V. The Broken Crossing
chapters.narration: A seal has failed near Mistwood. Algoreth and Tessa return to the ruins before the breach can reach Alsperia.

beats.speaker: Tessa
beats.text: The trees grow frost on one side and desert glass on the other. That is no season I know.

beats.speaker: Ilyra
beats.text: This breach has no chosen destination. It tears at every realm.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The ward holds for now. Dorian's question was a warning: a crossing needs purpose, not just power.

chapters.title: VI. Dorian's Testament
chapters.narration: At the arch, Dorian reveals why the scrolls were hidden. Each crossing binds Terralum to the world beyond it, and every opened road demands a keeper.

beats.speaker: Dorian
beats.text: I was the last keeper, not the last owner. No one can own a road between worlds.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: I came because Alsperia cannot leave its future to a closed door. I will stand beside you when you decide.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: A king may command a realm. A keeper must hear those who would walk the road.

chapters.title: VII. The Wizard King's Choice
chapters.narration: Algoreth stands before the throne. The scrolls are his, but their consequences belong to Terralum. His first decree will shape every crossing to come.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: The nobles ask you to rule by force. The scholars ask for open study. The border lords ask to burn the scrolls.

beats.speaker: Tessa
beats.text: People on the road will pay for a mistake first. Give them a voice before you open another gate.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Build a council to guard each crossing, and let no crown claim the roads alone.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: I accept the title Wizard King as a duty. Alsperia will keep the scrolls, and the five realms will be approached with consent and care.
